summary: Full E2E for Messaging Presence + Sage AI text-only fix on web and mobile. 14/14 backend tests PASS. Web: Active-now row + green dot, tap-to-open DM, Settings 'Appear offline' toggle (reciprocal persistence verified), DM typing bubble + header 'typing…', Sage AI text chat returns TEXT ONLY with ZERO audio.play() calls, sage-call-btn present. Mobile Expo preview: Active-now scroller + testIDs, tap-to-open DM, typing bubble + 'is typing…' header, privacy-appear-offline toggle persists via PUT /users/me/privacy. One minor missing data-testid on web Sage typing bubble added by me (sage-typing).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/presence/active correctly intersects outgoing + incoming follows for mutual friends, honors reciprocal appear_offline, filters blocked users, sorts online-first then by last_active_at desc. Clean.

/api/sage/send never returns audio_url and does not expose any TTS path — the audio is only generated under /api/sage/voice-turn which is strictly behind the phone-call button on the frontend. Verified assumption holds.
SageChat.jsx typing bubble was missing a data-testid — added data-testid="sage-typing" (testID fix only, no behavior change).
Typing indicator poll is 3.5s on web — a 'typing…' heartbeat can take up to ~5s to appear/disappear in the UI; acceptable UX.

AsyncStorage web shim stores values as JSON.stringify(value); for test-only token injection on the Expo preview I had to write JSON.stringify('<token>') into localStorage. Not a product bug, just a testing note.
test_credentials: Created disposable test_* users for every run (auto-purged on backend restart). Mutual-follow pairs test_mb3_a_* / test_mb3_b_* were the last mobile pair; test_webp_a_* / test_webp_b_* for web.
seed_data_creation: Each test flow registers two test_* users via /api/auth/register, mutually follows, and pings /api/presence/ping. No admin or founder credentials were needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web Sage typing bubble now has data-testid=sage-typing. For mobile Expo preview, AsyncStorage web shim stores values via JSON.stringify, so inject the JWT with: localStorage.setItem('postmeplex.token', JSON.stringify('<token>')) — then navigate. The green active dot on conv-list avatars (testid conv-online-{conv.id}) only renders when the peer is still within the 2-min ONLINE_WINDOW; backend presence window is 120s so pings need to be fresh.
